name: Find
author: spotty
long_description: Finds files and folders by name in the folders Spotty indexes (your home folder by default), and searches inside documents as well: text in PDF and Office files, and text in images through OCR. Enter opens the item. Nothing leaves this computer.

name: Clipboard
author: spotty
long_description: Keeps a history of what you copied (text, images and files) and finds an old item by its text. Enter copies it again, and Spotty can paste it into the app you were using.

name: Emoji
author: spotty
long_description: Finds emoji by name or keyword in a list built into Spotty, so it works offline. Enter copies the emoji you pick to the clipboard.

name: Bluetooth
author: spotty
long_description: Lists your Bluetooth devices through BlueZ (bluetoothctl) and connects, disconnects or pairs them. It can also scan for new devices and switch the adapter on or off. Nothing leaves this computer.

name: Apps
author: spotty
long_description: Finds the apps installed on this computer, from desktop entries and from Flatpak, Snap and AppImage programs, and opens them. It is part of the regular search, and nothing leaves this computer.

name: New Apps
author: spotty
long_description: Finds apps you can install: from Flathub and the Snap Store, and from your distribution's repositories (dnf or apt). Flathub and the Snap Store are searched over the network, so this needs a connection.

name: Web
author: spotty
long_description: Opens a web search for what you typed, in your browser, with the search engine you choose in Settings or in a private window. Spotty sends nothing itself: your browser makes the request.

name: Calculator
author: spotty
long_description: Evaluates arithmetic as you type, with the usual operators, brackets and powers. The result can show thousands grouping and a hex, octal or binary form. Enter copies the result, or pastes it if you choose that in Settings. It runs entirely on this computer.

name: Conversions
description: Convert units, currency and number bases
author: spotty
long_description: Converts units of length, mass, volume and more, number bases (hex, octal, binary and decimal), and currencies, typed next to the calculator. Units and bases are computed here. Currency rates are fetched only when a query names money; they are kept in memory for 12 hours and on disk, so conversions still work offline.

name: System Updates
description: Search and install system, Flatpak, Snap and AppImage updates
author: spotty
long_description: Checks for updates to system packages (dnf or apt), Flatpak apps, Snap apps and AppImages, shows what is pending, and installs the ones you choose. Installing uses your system's own authorization prompt, never a password typed into Spotty.
network: your distribution's package servers, Flathub and the Snap Store

name: Dictionary
author: spotty
long_description: Looks up an English word as you type and shows a short definition, from the free dictionaryapi.dev and Wiktionary services, with word suggestions from Datamuse. Enter opens the full entry on dictionary.com.

name: Translate
description: Translate text as you type — detects the language, free, no account needed
author: spotty
long_description: Translates text as you type. The language is detected automatically and the result is shown in your system language; text already in your system language goes to English. Single words also show alternative translations. Uses Google Translate's free service by default, with no account or key. In Settings you can switch to MyMemory, DeepL, Google Cloud, Microsoft Translator, Yandex or Kagi; services that need an API key say so, and keys stay in your keyring. Enter copies the translation.
network: translate.googleapis.com, or the translation service you pick in Settings
